0.reason: refusal wording for one edge case (named review exists but lacks the finding, nothing covers the plan); the answer path itself is correct and tested

findings.summary: when nothing covers the plan and the review named by --review-run exists but does not raise the finding, the refusal reports 'no stored review for <project>:<slug>' rather than naming the condition the plan says it tests, so a caller is told to compose a review instead of being told the id is not on the review it named.

the fragment says the gate ran 'at the node's final revision' but after3.txt's header records 46bf57624f and ruff.txt's header records 45d644e2fe, so the log headers do not name the revision the sentence implies.
rubric.durability reports change subjects and bodies rather than the test that fails if this regresses, so the dimension it claims to have answered is answered about a different property.
